title: Remove per-operation prerelease refusal handling from completion replay
outcome: Completion replay follows the repository-wide generic different-build policy without a poisoned per-operation legacy branch.
acceptance: Stored prerelease completion-refusal rows are handled only by the generic different-build contract

completion.summary: Replaced stale prerelease-build wording for replayed stored completion refusals with an identifier-free corrupt-projection error and added a restart-safe regression.
